snippet.title: Istaria: Chronicles of the Gifted
snippet.description: Istaria: Chronicles of the Gifted is a virtual world filled of fantastical characters.  You can choose to play a dryad, an elf, a dwarf, one of the mysterious saris or sslisk. And it is the only world where you can choose to be a dragon.  As you train your dragon related skills and grow, you eventually earn the gift of flight!  Join our outstanding community of players and become a part of Istaria!
